title: A Phase 1B Study to Investigate the Safety and Preliminary Efficacy for the Combination of Dasatinib Plus Nivolumab in Patients With Chronic Myeloid Leukemia

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this study is to find a dose of Nivolumab that can be safely added to Dasatinib in patients with Chronic Myeloid Leukemia.

Posted outcomes: Incidence of Dose Limiting Toxicities (DLT). timeframe=Week 3 to week 6. Dasatinib Only=0; Dose Level 1=0; Dose Level 2=0
